t: This is Queen Mary's Hospital in Roehampton, in the London Borough of Wandsworth. It began as Queen Mary's Convalescent Auxiliary Hospitals and is now a community hospital, run by St George's University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. Two people are recorded as having died here: George Ernest Haynes, a British social work administrator who lived from 1902 to 1983, and Dharam Hinduja, the son of Srichand Hinduja, who died in 1992 at the age of twenty-two or twenty-three.
